scene.ko: 언어 교환 친구에게 요즘 빠진 빵 굽기 취미와 어떻게 시작했는지 이야기한다.

lines.en: So, have you been up to anything fun lately?
lines.ko: 요즘 재밌는 거 하는 거 있어요?

lines.en: Actually, I've gotten really into baking bread.
lines.ko: 사실 요즘 빵 굽기에 푹 빠졌어요.
alt: Yeah, I've started baking bread, and I love it.
Actually, I'm really into baking bread these days.

lines.en: Oh, fun! How did you get into that?
I watched some videos during a long holiday and wanted to give it a try.
lines.ko: 긴 연휴에 영상을 몇 개 보다가 한번 해 보고 싶어졌어요.
alt: During a long holiday, I watched some baking videos and decided to try it.

lines.en: Is it hard? I always thought bread was tricky.
It was at first. My first few loaves were as hard as rocks!
lines.ko: 처음엔 그랬어요. 처음 몇 개는 돌처럼 딱딱했어요!
alt: At first, yes. My first loaves were hard as a rock!
Yeah, in the beginning. The first ones came out like rocks!

lines.en: Ha! But you've gotten better, right?
Much better. I'll bring you some next time we meet.
lines.ko: 훨씬 나아졌죠. 다음에 만날 때 좀 갖다줄게요.
alt: A lot better. I'll bring you a loaf next time.
Way better. Next time, I'll bring you some to try.

expressions.note: try 만 쓰는 것보다 자연스러운 말
지금은 달라졌다는 느낌 · It was hard at first.
